## Summary
- Rule available since: `v2.4.12`
- Diagnostic Category: [`lint/correctness/noJsxNamespace`](/reference/diagnostics#diagnostic-category)
- This rule is **recommended**, meaning it is enabled by default.
- This rule doesn't have a fix.
- The default severity of this rule is [**error**](/reference/diagnostics#error).
- This rule belongs to the following domains:
  - [`react`](/linter/domains#react)
- Sources: 
  - Same as [`react-jsx/no-namespace`](https://eslint-react.xyz/docs/rules/jsx-no-namespace)
  - Same as [`@eslint-react/jsx-no-namespace`](https://eslint-react.xyz/docs/rules/jsx-no-namespace)

## How to configure
```json title="biome.json"
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"correctness": {
				"noJsxNamespace": "error"
			}
		}
	}
}

```
## Description
Disallow JSX namespace syntax.

React does not support XML namespaced tags such as `<ns:Component />`.
Although the JSX specification permits namespaces, React does not implement
them and using a namespaced element may cause a runtime error.

## Examples

### Invalid

```jsx
<ns:testcomponent />
```
